note: The attacker-controlled compressed LZMA bytes are copied from the input stream according to the supplied size.
The uSWID parser invokes the LZMA decoder without a uSWID-specific memory limit in this vulnerable revision.
The decoder allows up to 4GB of memory for streams that declare a large LZMA dictionary.
The attacker-controlled LZMA stream is initialized with the excessive decoder memory limit; a large dictionary stream drives the vulnerable allocation/read behavior seen by the fuzzer.
